name: Arity-1 H-box is a Z-state
summary: An arity-1 H-box with label $e^{iα}$ is the Z-state with phase α.
description:
The arity-1 H-box with label $e^{i\alpha}$ is the state $|0\rangle + e^{i\alpha}|1\rangle$, which is the arity-1 Z-spider with phase $\alpha$. With $\alpha = 0$ and $\alpha = \pi$: the H-box labelled $1$ is the phase-free Z-state (the [unit rule](../zh-unit/)) and the standard H-box state is the Z-state with phase $\pi$.

(In the book the H-boxes are normalised with a factor $\frac{1}{\sqrt 2}$, which then appears here as a scalar.)
